name: Xuzhou Museum
note: Museum in Yunlong District holding Han jade burial suits and Han relics from the city's tombs (free).

name: Huaihai Campaign Memorial Museum
coordinates_source: osm:building Memorial Museum of the Huaihai Campaign (淮海战役纪念馆)
note: Museum and memorial park on the Huaihai Campaign of the Chinese Civil War, in Quanshan District.

name: Guishan Han Tombs
note: Western Han rock-cut tomb complex of Liu Zhu, King of Chu, in Guishan Scenic Area (historic site).

name: Lion Hill Han Tombs
note: Han-dynasty royal tomb of the Chu princes on Lion Hill (Shizishan), with a terracotta army and burial chambers.

name: Han Dynasty Terracotta Warriors Museum
coordinates_source: osm:building 徐州汉兵马俑博物馆
note: Museum on Lion Hill showing a Han-dynasty terracotta army and horses, a smaller counterpart to Xi'an's warriors.

name: Han Stone Relief Art Museum
note: Museum of Han-dynasty carved stone reliefs on the eastern bank of Yunlong Lake, holding more than a thousand stone sculptures (also called the Xuzhou Art Museum of Han Stone Carvings, one place).

name: Yunlong Lake
note: Scenic lake in southwest Xuzhou, a AAAAA-rated scenic area with bridges, pavilions and walks.

name: Yunlong Mountain
coordinates_source: osm:historic 云龙山——土山汉墓 (on the mountain)
note: Hill in southern Xuzhou with a Song-dynasty crane-flying pavilion, stone inscriptions and Xinghua Temple on its slope.

name: Xinghua Temple
note: Buddhist temple on Yunlong Mountain, one of the major temples of northern Jiangsu.

name: Yunlong Park
note: Park on the south side of Yunlong Lake (also known as Yanzilou Park), with gardens and water areas.

name: Xuzhou Aquarium
note: Aquarium on Huxin Island in Yunlong Lake, one of the largest in the city.

name: Xuzhou Botanical Garden
note: Botanical garden in Gulou District with hundreds of plant species and man-made streams.

name: Ximatai
note: Horse-training terrace on Hubu Hill where Xiang Yu is said to have trained horsemen, built around the Ming dynasty.

name: Hubu Hill Ancient Architecture Complex
note: Hubu Hill historic architecture complex in the city centre, with the Xuzhou Folk Museum in its two historic courtyard houses (Zhai and Yu family compounds).

name: Pengzu Garden
note: Garden in south Xuzhou on the site where Pengzu is said to have lived, with animals, water and cultural sights.

name: Happy Farming Garden
note: Agriculture and ecology park in the eastern development district with a precious animals and insects exhibit.

name: Zhulin Temple
note: Buddhist temple on Camel Mountain in Xuzhou, originally Qingyuan Temple, with a bamboo-forest setting.

name: Quanshan National Forest Park
note: Forest park on the five peaks of Mount Quanshan on the city's south side, known for trails and birdlife.

name: Xuzhou Imperial Decree Museum
coordinates_source: osm:building 徐州中国圣旨博物馆
note: Museum of imperial decrees in the Jiuli Mountain Han Culture Tourism Zone (single listing, not confirmed by a second visitor source).

name: Xuzhou City Wall Museum
note: Museum displaying an excavated section of the Ming city wall in situ (Wikipedia only; no visitor listing found).

name: Sishuiting Park
note: Urban park in Xuzhou with a Surabaya Pavilion, named in the city's Wikipedia article (no visitor listing found).

name: Xuzhou Cathedral of the Sacred Heart
wiki: Xuzhou Cathedral of the Sacred Heart
note: Catholic cathedral in Xuzhou named in its Wikipedia article (a church, judged on its visitor source).

name: Dadong Mountain
note: Highest point of Xuzhou (361 m), a limestone inselberg in the region (Wikipedia only).

name: Pan'an Lake
note: Artificial wetland lake created on former coal-subsidence land in Jiawang (Wikipedia only).

name: Gefeng Terrace
note: Historic terrace in Pei County commemorating Liu Bang's Ode to the Wind, in Hancheng Park near the Han City scenic area.

name: Han City Scenic Area (Peixian)
note: Han-era scenic area in Pei County with Han Street and the Han Gaozu Temple, Liu Bang's ancestral temple (search result only, no fetched listing).

name: Pei County Museum
note: County museum in Pei County with over 2,000 cultural relics and a statue of Liu Bang in its lobby (search result only).

name: Mausoleum of the Han Emperor (Liuzhai)
note: Han-era mausoleum site in Feng County near Liuzhai (search result only; not confirmed by a visitor listing).

name: Lianyungang Museum
note: City museum at Haizhou on Chaoyang Road East, closed Mondays, with local history and archaeology.

name: White Tiger Mountain Party Memorial Pavilion
wiki: White Tiger Mountain Party Memorial Pavilion
coordinates_source: osm:natural=peak 白虎山 (memorial on the mountain)
note: Memorial pavilion on White Tiger Mountain marking the founding of the CCP East China Sea special branch (a commemorative plaque, not a sight in itself).

name: Mount Kangri Martyrs' Cemetery
note: Martyrs' cemetery on Kangri (Kangri Mountain) for anti-Japanese war dead, a free public memorial park.

name: Kongwang Mountain Cliff Carvings
note: Han-dynasty Buddhist cliff sculptures on Kongwang Mountain in south Haizhou, among the oldest in China.

name: Haizhou Bay
note: Bay on the Yellow Sea off Lianyungang with a fishery and coastline (OpenStreetMap bay with a Wikipedia link; no visitor listing yet).

name: Haizhou Ancient City
note: Historic walled town centre of Haizhou district, often paired with Kongwangshan on day tours (search result only).

name: Langya County Boundary Stone
note: Han-era boundary stone carving of the Langya commandery, a protected cultural relic in the city.

name: Erlangshen Cultural Relics Park
coordinates_source: osm:leisure=park 二郎神文化遗址公园
note: Cultural relics park in Guannan County on the Erlangshen legend site, with temple buildings and a stage area.

name: Yinwan Han Tomb
note: Western Han tomb complex in Hot Springs town of Donghai County with bamboo slips and a key cultural relic protection status.

name: Tanggou Wine Industry
note: Tanggou liquor producer in Guannan County, a distillery making a registered traditional wine (operator, visitor tours not confirmed).

name: Donghai Crystal City
note: Crystal trade centre in Donghai County, the national crystal capital, with shops and crystal markets (a trade centre, not a sight).

name: Xishuang Lake
coordinates_source: osm:leisure=park 东海县西双湖国家湿地公园
note: Scenic lake in Donghai County with an ecological park, wetland and botanical park.

name: Mount Huaguo
note: Mountain scenic area in Lianyungang, the Monkey King's legendary home in Journey to the West, with a AAAA-plus rating.

name: Water Curtain Cave
note: Cave behind a waterfall on Mount Huaguo, the home of the Monkey King in the novel Journey to the West.

name: Yunu Peak
note: Highest point of Jiangsu (624 m) on Mount Huaguo, with sunrise views from Yinshu Pavilion.

name: Sanyuan Palace
note: Haining Zen temple halfway up Mount Huaguo, an architectural complex of Buddhist halls.

name: Yuntai Mountain
note: Coastal mountain range near Lianyungang with waterfalls, villages, tea and a coastal promenade, the highest peak in Jiangsu's range.

name: Yuwan Scenic Area
coordinates_source: osm:tourism=attraction 渔湾风景区(东南门)
note: Scenic area at the southern foot of Yuntai Mountain with running waterfalls, rocks and cliffs.

name: Taohuajian Scenic Area
note: Scenic valley on the southern foothills of Jinping Mountain, known for its spring peach blossom.

name: Lian Island
note: Largest sea island in Jiangsu, linked to Lianyungang by a 6.7 km sea dyke, with beaches, forest and a seaside pool.

name: Sumawan Beach
note: Small beach on Lian Island reached by a walk along a wooden path from Xugou (a beach stop on the island).

name: Fenghuangwan Beach
note: Coastal beach northeast of Lianyungang, reached by bus from Xinpu (a bathing beach).

name: Qinshan Island
note: Sea island off Ganyu District with a pebble-beach causeway to the mainland, a 20 m natural ridge and a coastal resort.

name: Dayi Mountain
note: Mountain scenic area in Guanyun County, a provincial-level tourist resort (search result and county page only).

name: Kaishan Island
coordinates_source: osm:natural=coastline 开山岛 (island; location conflicts with Wikipedia Guanyun attribution, verify)
note: Island scenic region in Guanyun County named on the county's Wikipedia article (no visitor listing found).

name: Xuzhou Han Culture Scenic Area
coordinates_source: osm:leisure=park 徐州汉城 (Han City scenic area)
note: Han culture scenic area (Han City) in Xuzhou's Jiuli district, a cluster of Han sites including the Han terracotta museum and the Guishan Han tomb area (the scenic area itself, not one attraction).
